name: pi-kb
description: Pi extension for a progressive-disclosure general knowledge base. Reuses the same ~/.agents/kb knowledge base (directory-tree categories with optional categories.yml overlay, front-matter + body markdown entries) as the DSH dsh-kb plugin, exposing kb_cate
